entries.review: passes standalone Stage II review. It has the exact sign, a taller residential form, an enclosed private sky lounge beside its longer rooftop infinity pool, a prominent facade screen, and dry street frontage. Its foundation leaves room for street layers.

passes delegated Stage III review. The front curb and crosswalk visually align with Skyline Habitat, correcting the prior roughly 95 px vertical offset. The taller crown clears the top of frame, and the full dry foundation leaves foreground street space. The exact mounted sign, enlarged infinity pool, separate upper pools, glazed resort lounge, restrained low planting, and two prominent screens carry through. The intervening planting-only edit was excluded from selection because it retained the old footprint.
passes delegated Stage II review. The twin canopies, glazed bridge, tiered shops and escalators carry the reference architecture forward, with exact signage, clear site margins and open foreground.

passes delegated Stage III review. Its taller joined crown, two bridges and layered storefronts increase height and program. The exact sign is legible. The full crown clears the top edge, and the curb and road align visually with Stage II.

passes Stage II review. The lab floors raise the antenna tip to about y160 versus y277 for HoloTech Tower while keeping the front curb near y1260, the supported single wing, orbital display and exact sign.

passes delegated Stage III review. The front curb, platform and crosswalk align visually with Quantum Spire v2. Its antenna tip sits near y65 versus y160 for Stage II, and the wider supported halo and twin glazed robotics labs clearly extend the Stage II program. The exact mounted name and orbital display remain legible.

revision_history.review: has exact signage, a taller crown, a multi-zone sky resort with larger and additional pools, dry street frontage, and two displays whose combined visible area exceeds Stage II. Keep this as a revision candidate. The front foundation sits about 95 px below Stage II, and the crown and base leave less scene space. Reframe against the Stage II common site anchor and reduce rooftop planting to small accents while retaining the resort program and screen presence.

retains exact signage, the orbital facade display and a visibly supported single laboratory wing. The antenna has about 33 px of sky clearance against the 47 px minimum, and the platform sits lower than the Stage I site. Reframe to the Stage I curb with at least 47 px above the antenna.

retains exact signage, the larger supported halo, two lab wings and layered annexes. The antenna is about 46 px from the top, and the total silhouette reads slightly shorter than Stage II. Reframe both portraits to the same Stage I curb, lower the Stage II tip to about y180, and target about y75 for the Stage III tip to give the family a clear height progression.

now clears the 47 px minimum with an antenna tip near y65 and reads taller than Quantum Spire. It keeps the exact sign, large supported halo and twin labs. Its front curb still sits about 100 px below the common Stage I/II curb. For the next edit use the selected Quantum Spire v2 as the first reference and transplant the Omninet architecture onto that exact pavement and street, holding the tip near y65.
